item.title: Shaboozey and Ciara Miller Give ‘Cowgirl’ A Whirl on Late-Night TV
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script:
[Upbeat music fades out]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! We've got some exciting news for fans of Shaboozey. His Outlaws era is in full swing, with a new album dropping this Friday, July 31st, and a major tour kicking off in September."
[Short music clip from "Cowgirl"]
Host: "You might have caught Shaboozey's performance of 'Cowgirl' on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon last Wednesday. The set was transformed into a Wild West saloon, complete with Ciara Miller, star of Bravo's Summer House, reprising her role from the official music video."
[Short music clip from "Cowgirl" continues]
Host: " 'Cowgirl' is the follow-up to 'Born To Die', both tracks lifted from Shaboozey's forthcoming concept album, The Outlaw Cherie Lee & Other Western Tales. This album promises to be a wild ride, with a Western-themed story of vengeance, love, and transformation, told through Americana, hip-hop, and pop."
[Short music clip fades out]
Host: "The Outlaw Cherie Lee is the successor to Shaboozey's breakout project, Where I've Been, Isn't Where I'm Going. And, if you're a fan, you know Shaboozey's capable of creating massive hits – like 'A Bar Song (Tipsy)', which spent a record-breaking 19 weeks at the top of the Billboard Hot 100."
[Music transitions to a teaser for the tour]
Host: "Shaboozey's Outlaws Never Die Tour starts September 8th at the Arizona Financial Theatre. Don't miss out! And, if you haven't seen it yet, check out his late-night performance of 'Cowgirl' – link in our show notes."
[Music and host continue for another 2 seconds before fading out]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this episode of Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you in the next one!"
